_: Saved documents whose INPUT key is a table function declared after members could save documents (closedTable.json::_functions_added_after_saved_documents). Read by BOTH lanes: app/src/components/chart/engine/ast/interpret.inputCompat.test.js and tests/test_ast_input_compat.py. Each `saved` document must compute exactly what the same document computes with its input under a key no table holds (`control_key`), i.e. what it computed before the table declared the name. `old_names` must still raise: an input shadowing a name the table held before saved documents existed is a wiring defect. `call_refused` is a document whose input took the name AND whose tree calls the function of that name: the call is refused resolve:function, by name.
